note: Weekly per-game PPR projections: season ppg x opponent def-vs-pos multiplier (PPR allowed/gm vs league avg — def-vs-pos blends 2026 weeks 1-8 at 57% over 2025 — deviation shrunk to 40% of observed, clamped [0.82,1.18]) x home/away (1.02/0.98), normalized to mean 1.0 per team so weeks sum to the season line, with the swing around 1 scaled per position (QB 1.0, RB 0.5, WR 0.7, TE 1.75 — fitted out of sample on 2026 weeks 1-6 by scripts/score-weekly-projections.py; matchupScale carries the scales in force). null = bye. Points assume the player plays; gp carries the season games discount. Half/Std: pts - 0.5*rec or pts - rec, where weekly rec scales with the same multiplier (rec_w = recPG * pts_w / ppg). statsPG = the season stat line per game (QB passAtt/passComp/passYds/passTD/int + rushing; RB/WR/TE rushing + tgt/rec/recYds/recTD). A week's stat line, with m = wk[w] / ppg: volume (passAtt, passComp, int, rushAtt, tgt) stays at statsPG, rec scales by m, yards by 1 + statSplit.ky * (m - 1) and TDs by 1 + statSplit.kt * (m - 1) — a matchup does not change how many carries or targets a player gets (measured swing ~0), it changes yards and above all TDs (TDs carry 2x the yards' share); ky/kt are solved per player so the line still prices to ppg * m, so weekly stat lines sum back to the season line and any scoring system can be priced per week. Availability (inj / status) scales every component alike. roleAdj (RB carries / targets, QB carries): the line is scaled by a share-based volume update — half the pool's per-game volume, half his recency-weighted share of the team's recent volume (half-life 2 games / 3 weeks) — components scaled with the volume they ride on, factor = the resulting change in points (clamped ratio [0.5, 1.6]); measured on 2026 weeks 4-6 it cut RB carries MAE 3.26 -> 3.22 and RB / QB points MAE 4.83 -> 4.77 / 5.47 -> 5.44, and was a wash for WR / TE targets, which stay with the pool. This week's absences are not redistributed here (the MCP's next-man-up pass does that at query time). gsis/sleeper ids stamped from the player crosswalk (null when the player has no NFL gsis yet). K/DST (one per team): season line = league avg + shrunk team deviation (0.5/0.4); K rows use the current depth-chart PK1 (own prior PPG blended 50/50 when >=8 games); K scoring FG 3/4/5 by distance + XP; DST scoring sack 1 / INT 2 / fum rec 2 / TD 6 / safety 2 + standard points-allowed brackets; defVsPos[T].K = K pts defense T allows, defVsPos[T].DST = DST pts offense T concedes. Sleeper DST id = team code. IDP (DL/LB/DB, top 96 per bucket by default-catalog points): the season component build split across the schedule, scored tackle 1 / sack 2 / INT 3 / fum rec 2 / TD 6 / safety 2 — re-price from the components on the season board. The IDP matchup swing is small by construction: how much an offense concedes to a bucket barely repeats year over year (r = +0.25 DL, +0.24 LB, +0.08 DB), so the deviation is kept at 24%/24%/8% of observed and sharpens as in-season weeks blend in.
actualsNote: act / actRec = actual PPR points and receptions per REG week from the nflverse game logs, for weeks already played (<= playedThrough); null where the player did not play. Re-score with the same reception arithmetic as the projections: half = act - 0.5*actRec, std = act - actRec, TE premium = act + bonus*actRec.
injuryNote: inj = the newest weekly injury report (nflverse): status Out / Doubtful / Questionable, the report week and the final practice status (Full / Limited / DNP). slp = Sleeper's live status, kept only when it speaks to currentWeek (IR / PUP / Sus always; Out / Doubtful / Questionable only if updated after the team's last kickoff). The strip is NOT discounted here. Apply as an expected-value multiplier for the report's own week (slp: currentWeek), official report first: Out / IR / PUP / Sus → 0, Doubtful → 0 (1% played, 2016-2025), Questionable ×0.63, or by final practice Full ×0.80 / Limited ×0.64 / DNP ×0.39 (scripts/measure-injury-designations.py). For a later week show it as an unconfirmed flag: last week's Out is not this week's. gd = the game-day call for currentWeek once the team posts its inactive list (~90 min before kickoff; RotoWire via scripts/fetch-gameday-inactives.py) and it overrides both: inactive → 0; active → the measured if-played multiplier (Questionable Full ×0.91 / Limited ×0.88 / DNP ×0.77, else ×0.88; Doubtful ×0.58; undesignated ×1). qbc = this week's QB starter call (RotoWire, since the team's last game): firm / likely / not. Resolve per team: the newest firm/likely call names the starter, who starts with P 0.95 / 0.85 (times his own availability) while the QB1 keeps the rest; a not call on the QB1 alone leaves him 5%.
statusNote: status = nflverse roster status at build time (ACT active, RES reserve/IR/PUP, EXE commissioner exempt, DEV practice squad, INA game-day inactive, FA not on any roster; null when no roster file). active=false rows (RES/EXE/DEV/FA) have every week from currentWeek on zeroed — they are kept so a consumer can see who is out and restore the strip the day the roster flips back to ACT; wkIfActive on those rows is the un-zeroed conditional strip, for consumers that redistribute the vacated production. RET/CUT rows are dropped. backup=true marks a 1-3 game line for a depth-2+ player: a per-game rate conditional on playing, to be ranked below starters. playedThrough counts a week only once every scheduled game in it is final; currentWeek = playedThrough + 1.
marketNote: Weeks with a published market line use the implied team total as the scoring-environment term, blended 60% against def-vs-pos team strength, with the home/away nudge dropped (the line prices home field) and the position-specific deviation from def-vs-pos still applied on top. Over 3,726 team-games (2019-2025) an implied total predicts actual points at RMSE 9.13 against 10.16 for prior-season points per game and 10.20 for the current season to date — it subsumes what we knew. The weight is below 1 on purpose: that measurement used CLOSING lines, while what is published in advance is a lookahead price. Caveat: the market term is normalized over a team's LINED games and the fallback over all of them, so the split between lined and unlined weeks is approximate; the season total is unaffected, since all 17 weeks are renormalized to mean 1.
rosNote: rosPts / rosGames / rosPPG / gamesRemaining cover weeks after 8 (0 = preseason, so they equal the full season). rosPts already carries the availability discount (gp/17); rosPPG does not — it is the per-game rate over the remaining slate, which differs from the season ppg when the rest of the schedule is easier or harder than the part already played.
